anya: Rolled role-propagation-1.0 a few minutes ago and noticed some viewers in org-12 can't open Settings -> Billing. They get a 403 in the Console even though org API shows viewer. Repro below. :frowning:

samir: Which deploy tag and migrator run?

anya: deploy=role-propagation-1.0, migrator run id=mig-20260105-02. Example: user u_210 on org-12, project p_markets. API calls:
`GET /api/v1/orgs/org-12/permissions?user=u_210` -> `{ "user":"u_210","role":"viewer","permissions":["view_project","billing:read"] }`
`GET /api/v1/projects/p_markets/permissions?user=u_210` -> `{ "user":"u_210","role":null,"permissions":[] }`

diana: Looks like the migrator wrote explicit empty project rows rather than leaving them nil/inherit. Can you check rbac_migration state?

anya: `select state from rbac_migration where org_id='org-12';` -> `partial` and last_step=`map_aliases`.

infra-bot: migrator run mig-20260105-02 started at 2026-01-05T02:14Z by rbac-migrator@infra. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/mig-20260105-02

samir: Check KMS: if alias decryption failed we can end up writing blanks. @diana can you pull KMS audit for that run id?

diana: KMS shows a transient `DECRYPT_NOT_AUTHORIZED` at 02:15:09Z for key `projects/ri/locations/global/keyRbac` then retries succeeded. Short window of auth noise.

sec-oncall: Impact P2 (UX/regression). No privilege escalation, but customer-facing. Action plan: 1) requeue migrator for org-12 with verbose logs and KMS retry/backoff, 2) add temporary UI fallback to check org perms when project perms empty, flagged behind `ui.rbac.org-fallback`, 3) if migrator remains partial run idempotent backfill for affected orgs, audited.

anya: Requeue command sent. infra-bot: job queued: migrator-reconcile org=org-12 run_id=mig-20260105-02-retry verbose=true (eta ~90s).

diana: Re-run finished at 2026-01-05T02:36Z; migrator status org-12 -> complete. Post-check: project perms now inherit billing:read.

samir: Frontend patch merged: `ui.rbac.org-fallback` enabled for org-12 during the window and then disabled after verification. Telemetry `rbac.ui.fallback_used` recorded 1 event.

sec-oncall: Follow-ups: add KMS retry/backoff in migrator, emit audit entry when migrator marks `partial`, alert if `partial` > 5m, and add migration preflight to validate KMS IAM. Assign owners in INC-20260105-3.

anya: Verified with user u_210. Closing incident and will update the ticket with run ids and log links. :lock:
